In such view of the matter, the petitioner seeks for interim bail.

opennyai_summary.decision:
In view of such facts and circumstances, it is directed that the petitioner be released on interim bail for a period of one month reckoning from the date of his actual release on interim bail by the court in seisin over the matter in the aforesaid case on such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper by the court in seisin over the matter including the conditions that:-
// 3 // i. the petitioner shall surrender before the court in seisin over the matter on or before the exact date of completion of interim bail period; ii. the petitioner shall appear before the I.I.C., Sinapali Police Station on every Monday in between 10 A.M.
to 1 P.M. during the period of interim bail.
iii. the petitioner shall not threaten the informant or any family members of the informant in any manner and also shall not influence any witness while on interim bail.
8. Violation of any of the conditions shall entail cancellation of the interim bail granted to the petitioner.
9. Accordingly, the I.A. is disposed of.
10. List this matter on 1st July, 2024.
11.
Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
